scope: React/Vite runtime-truth marker ownership during modify/state preservation flow
root_cause: Modify/state-preservation copied src/main.tsx from latest or active run with an existing runtime-truth div. Truth marker injection only inserted a marker when <App /> existed and did not remove inherited markers first, so the new run could retain the previous run-id.

behavior.before: Inherited runtime-truth marker could keep data-run-id from the previous run.
behavior.after: React/Vite truth injection removes any existing runtime-truth div regardless of run-id, then injects a new marker using the current run_id.

validation.proof: run_20260606_123512_maaoj5 replaced inherited run_20260606_123351_23sttp and latest synced to the new run marker

generate_validation_note: A deterministic create+modify generate run confirmed the run folder marker changed from run_20260606_124801_8btrd5 to run_20260606_124824_sv3qmq. The end-to-end modify run did not complete due to an unrelated runtime/provider condition, so latest sync was validated with the direct state-preservation marker test.
